name: Política Nacional de Defesa e Estratégia Nacional de Defesa (2025)
description: Política Nacional de Defesa e Estratégia Nacional de Defesa (Decreto nº 12.725, November 18, 2025). Brazil's overarching national security and defense strategy documents mandated every four years by Complementary Law No. 97/1999 (as amended by Complementary Law No. 136/2010), designating the cyber, nuclear, and space sectors as strategic national defense priorities.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Governo Federal do Brasil (gov.br) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Governo Federal do Brasil (gov.br).
